hooks.text: 每回合抽7枚硬币，先重排再同时翻面，并通过互相触发与重翻冲击目标分数。
hooks.excerpt: You play by drawing 7 coins from your deck, rearranging and then flipping them all at once. With strategic planning and more than a little luck, they can trigger & reflip each other; destroying the target score
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 每枚硬币的正反面都能分别升级，可做均衡牌组，也可把全部资源押在一枚硬币上。
hooks.excerpt: Upgrade the heads, tails or both sides of each coin in order to create a balanced deck, or put everything on one coin and pray to the gods that it lands heads and breaks the game.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 硬币取材自希腊神话人物，沿冥界河流挑战摆渡人，渡过后进入Asphodel无尽模式。
hooks.excerpt: Journey through the Rivers of the Underworld, from Styx to Phlegethon; each river will test you in different ways. Cross to the other side and try your luck in the endless mode, Asphodel.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: the presentation, which is top-notch across the board.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 持续存在的硬币正反面随机性让每回合保持趣味。

excerpts.excerpt: The constant state of chance of coin flips keeps it interesting every round!
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 简单规则之下存在大量构筑深度。

excerpts.excerpt: Beneath that simplicity, however, is an incredible amount of depth.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 策略、协同与不可预测的硬币结果让每局从头到尾保持兴奋。

excerpts.excerpt: the mix of strategy, charm synergies, and unpredictable coin flips keeps the runs exciting from start to finish.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 双面硬币机制为牌组构筑带来独特且有趣的变化。

excerpts.excerpt: Really fun game with a cool twist on the standard deckbuilders.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 冥河地下世界旅行主题赋予游戏独特身份。

excerpts.excerpt: Travelling through the underworld along the River Styx gives the game a unique identity
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 整体主题和氛围受到玩家喜爱。

excerpts.excerpt: I also really like the overall theme and atmosphere.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段
